answer: Treat admission like cargo that must dock at a narrow jetty before it can vote or grade. The new key posts a locked berth deposit, then completes one non-reusable paid job for each of several established buyers with distinct funding paths. Every buyer leaves a signed whisper naming the job hash, the berth, and the elapsed wait. Those records accrete as a public reef; if many keys share one wallet graph or arrive in lockstep, peers fuse them and slash the deposit. A farm therefore cannot mint cheap identical seats.
